name: Schengen Short-Stay Visa / Visa-Exempt Entry

qualifying_event.description: Nationals of visa-exempt countries (EU/Schengen states, and 60+ third countries under EU Regulation 2018/1806 Annex II, plus several Balkan and other biometric-passport nations) may enter Hungary (Schengen area) without a visa for short stays. Other third-country nationals require a Schengen (Type C) short-stay visa from a Hungarian consulate or another Schengen state's mission.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Valid passport; for visa applicants: proof of purpose, funds, return travel, insurance.

requirements.blocker_text: Maximum stay of 90 days within any 180-day period. Overstaying this window is grounds for future visa refusal.

evidence_required.document: Schengen (Type C) visa, if not visa-exempt

outcome.duration_length: up to 90 days within any 180-day period

sources.title: Hungarian Ministry of Foreign Affairs Consular Service -- Short Term Stay: visa-exempt nationalities, 90/180-day rule, visa fee waivers for students/pupils

notes: NEW ROUTE, first route of Hungary's initial build. Hungary has been a full Schengen member since 2007. Confirmed directly at tier-1. dual_citizenship_allowed reflects Hungary's general policy (Hungary permits dual/multiple citizenship, notably reinforced by the post-2010 simplified naturalisation reforms which do not require renouncing other citizenships), not something specific to this route.
